columns.name: hs6
columns.description: 6-digit Harmonized System code.

columns.name: hs2
columns.description: HS chapter (first 2 digits).

columns.name: hs4
columns.description: HS heading (first 4 digits).

columns.name: description
columns.description: Eurostat HS6 product description (English).

columns.name: us_base_rate_pct
columns.description: US base (column 1 general) duty in percent; null unless every US line under the HS6 is the same plain ad valorem rate. 0 = Free.

columns.name: us_rate_published
columns.description: US general rates as published, distinct values separated by ' | '. Null when the HS6 has no US line.

columns.name: eu_base_rate_pct
columns.description: EU third-country duty in percent; null unless every TARIC code under the HS6 carries the same plain ad valorem duty.

columns.name: eu_rate_published
columns.description: EU third-country duties as published, distinct values separated by ' | '. Null when the extract holds no such duty.

columns.name: ca_base_rate_pct
columns.description: Canada MFN duty in percent; null unless every line under the HS6 is the same plain ad valorem rate.

columns.name: ca_rate_published
columns.description: Canada MFN rates as published, distinct values separated by ' | '.

columns.name: au_base_rate_pct
columns.description: Australia general duty in percent; null unless every line under the HS6 is the same plain ad valorem rate.

columns.name: au_rate_published
columns.description: Australia general rates as published (preferential markers removed), distinct values separated by ' | '.

columns.name: flow_year
columns.description: Calendar year of the trade flows (2025).

columns.name: eu27_import_value_eur
columns.description: EU27 imports from non-EU countries, value in EUR. Null when Comext gives no value.

columns.name: eu27_import_weight_kg
columns.description: EU27 extra-EU imports, net mass in kg. Null when not given.

columns.name: eu27_import_top_partners
columns.description: Top 3 supplier countries of EU27 imports: partner_code (ISO), partner_name, value_eur, share_pct of the extra-EU total. Null when the partner figures do not reconcile with the total.

columns.name: eu27_import_partner_codes
columns.description: ISO codes of the top 3 import partners (for filtering).

columns.name: eu27_export_value_eur
columns.description: EU27 exports to non-EU countries, value in EUR. Null when Comext gives no value.

columns.name: eu27_export_weight_kg
columns.description: EU27 extra-EU exports, net mass in kg. Null when not given.

columns.name: eu27_export_top_partners
columns.description: Top 3 destination countries of EU27 exports: partner_code (ISO), partner_name, value_eur, share_pct. Null when the partner figures do not reconcile with the total.

columns.name: eu27_export_partner_codes
columns.description: ISO codes of the top 3 export partners (for filtering).
